newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight- Just a handful of orders, fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight- Just a handful of orders, fixtures.

text.p: Demand dried up in sugar freight at the end of the week after Thursday's swathe of orders but a few ships were fixed, brokers said.
E.D. & F. Man was among just a handful of buyers on Friday for 19,000 tonnes bulk East coast Mexico to Morocco or Black Sea promt.
Gill and Duffus had 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar from Puerto Quetzal to Colombo for any date in January. They also amended their Cuba/Egypt for promty loading to 11,000 to 14,000 tonnes.
Dreyfus were reported to be fully fixed on 14,000 bulk Thailand/South Korea end-Jan at about $17.
Man concluded 10,000 tonnes bagged sugar from Thailand to Japan for prompt shipment at a rate between $17 and $20, shipbrokers said.
